purpose: Capture current Sandero Journey grade-page dependency evidence that can be read without interactive configurator switching.

source.primary: Official Dacia Poland Sandero Journey version-and-price page accessed through connected Opera session.
source.negative_evidence_rule: Current omission or availability is not evidence of historical unavailability.

highlighted_equipment: felgi ze stopu metali lekkich 16" TAMIA

dependency_observations.observation: The current Journey grade page exposes four engine choices: TCe 100, Eco-G 120, Eco-G 120 auto and hybrid 155.
The current Journey grade page exposes seven colors.
The current Journey grade page highlights automatic climate control, Keyless Entry card, digital instrument cluster and 16-inch TAMIA alloy wheels.
The page provides a generic configuration entry point, but the connected Opera connector cannot invoke the page's configurator controls.

access_boundary.limitation: No click/press invocation primitive is available, so the Journey live configurator cannot be entered and switched through this connector.
access_boundary.consequence: No live Journey option-compatibility matrix is synthesized.

reconciliation.action: No master-data mutation; current-web observations remain reporting/provenance only.

next_scope.target: Live Journey configurator option compatibility after a reproducible interactive action surface becomes available.
